# font-rs

The crate font-rs 0.1.3 (Raph Levien, Copyright 2015 Google Inc.,
Apache-2.0, `LICENSE`), vendored with one change (`PATCHED.md`). og-text's
glyph coverage (`crates/og-text/src/raster.rs`) calls it.

`crates/og-ui/src/text/colr.rs` holds an older hand port of its
accumulation rasterizer; it is deleted with og_ui.
